question: By whose agency and will was the yoginī named Icchā transmitted up to the level of māyā?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is mentioned.
The siddhas are involved as agents.
The transmission extends up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact verbal action governing the transmission is implicit.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā was conveyed by the siddhas up to the limit of māyā by supreme will.
